title: Degree: minor
instructions: Choose the word that best preserves the exact meaning, degree and attitude supported by the sentence.

parts.prompt: The storm caused ___ damage: two roof panels loosened, but every room remained safe and dry.

choice_rationales.A: Catastrophic describes disastrous damage and contradicts the rooms remaining safe and dry.
choice_rationales.B: Minor expresses limited seriousness and matches the small repair described.
choice_rationales.C: Serious would suggest a meaningful threat or major consequence that the sentence explicitly rules out.
choice_rationales.D: Extensive concerns wide scope, but only two panels were affected.

parts.hint: Use both the number of affected panels and the absence of danger to set the degree.
parts.correct_explanation: The damage is limited in scope and consequence, so ‘minor’ is the proportionate choice.
